english: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
chinese: 千里之行，始于足下。

english: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
chinese: 跌倒七次，也要第八次站起来。

english: This too shall pass.
chinese: 这一切终将过去。

english: No matter how long the winter, spring is sure to follow.
chinese: 无论冬天多么漫长，春天终会到来。

english: Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors.
chinese: 平静的海面，练不出真正的水手。

english: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
chinese: 种树最好的时间是二十年前，其次就是现在。
source: Modern proverb, often described as Chinese

english: A rising tide lifts all boats.
chinese: 水涨众船高。

english: Where there is life, there is hope.
chinese: 只要生命还在，希望就还在。

english: Better late than never.
chinese: 迟做总比不做好。

english: After rain comes fair weather.
chinese: 雨过终会天晴。

english: A problem shared is a problem halved.
chinese: 烦恼有人分担，就会减轻一半。

english: Two heads are better than one.
chinese: 三个臭皮匠，胜过一个诸葛亮。

english: Measure twice, cut once.
chinese: 三思而后行。

english: The darkest hour is just before dawn.
chinese: 黎明前往往最黑暗。

english: Little strokes fell great oaks.
chinese: 滴水不断，也能穿石；小斧不停，也能伐倒大树。

english: Many hands make light work.
chinese: 众人拾柴火焰高。

english: A calm sea never made a good sailor.
chinese: 风平浪静，造就不了优秀的水手。

english: When one door closes, another opens.
chinese: 一扇门关上时，另一扇门会打开。

english: Every cloud has a silver lining.
chinese: 乌云背后总有一线光明。

english: Fortune favors the brave.
chinese: 幸运偏爱勇敢的人。

english: He who asks is a fool for five minutes; he who does not ask remains a fool forever.
chinese: 肯问的人只糊涂五分钟；不问的人会糊涂一辈子。
source: Often presented as a Chinese proverb

english: A bird does not sing because it has an answer; it sings because it has a song.
chinese: 鸟儿歌唱，不是因为已有答案，而是因为心中有歌。
source: Often attributed as a Chinese proverb

english: The bamboo that bends is stronger than the oak that resists.
chinese: 懂得弯曲的竹子，比一味硬撑的橡树更坚韧。

english: Even monkeys fall from trees.
chinese: 再熟练的人也会失手。

english: Vision without action is a daydream; action without vision is a nightmare.
chinese: 只有理想没有行动，是白日梦；只有行动没有方向，是噩梦。

english: The reputation of a thousand years may be determined by one hour.
chinese: 千年声誉，也可能由一小时决定。

english: The nail that sticks out gets hammered down.
chinese: 出头的钉子容易挨锤。

english: A single arrow is easily broken, but not ten in a bundle.
chinese: 一支箭容易折断，十支箭捆在一起就很难折断。

english: The frog in the well knows nothing of the great ocean.
chinese: 井底之蛙，不知大海。

english: If you understand everything, you must be misinformed.
chinese: 若你觉得一切都完全明白，可能只是知道得还不够。

english: A society grows great when old people plant trees whose shade they know they shall never sit in.
chinese: 老人种下明知自己无法乘凉的树，社会才真正走向伟大。

english: Know thyself.
chinese: 认识你自己。

english: The beginning is half of the whole.
chinese: 良好的开始，等于成功的一半。

english: Character is destiny.
chinese: 性格决定命运。
source: Ancient Greek saying, associated with Heraclitus

english: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
chinese: 耐心或许苦涩，但它结出的果实甘甜。

english: The fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing.
chinese: 狐狸知道许多事，刺猬只知道一件大事。

english: One hand cannot clap.
chinese: 孤掌难鸣。

english: Trust in God, but tie your camel.
chinese: 信任上天，也要拴好骆驼。

english: He who has health has hope; he who has hope has everything.
chinese: 拥有健康，就拥有希望；拥有希望，就拥有一切。

english: The wound of words is worse than the wound of swords.
chinese: 言语造成的伤口，有时比刀剑更深。

english: Dawn does not come twice to awaken a person.
chinese: 黎明不会来两次叫醒同一个人。

english: A book is a garden carried in the pocket.
chinese: 书，是装进口袋里的花园。

english: Ask the experienced rather than the learned.
chinese: 遇事多问有经验的人，不只问有学问的人。

english: He who wants a rose must respect the thorn.
chinese: 想要玫瑰，也要尊重它的刺。

english: Little by little, the bird builds its nest.
chinese: 一点一点，鸟儿筑起自己的巢。

english: To understand all is to forgive all.
chinese: 真正理解之后，便更容易宽容。

english: The appetite comes with eating.
chinese: 开始行动以后，动力会随之而来。

english: Everyone is the architect of their own fortune.
chinese: 每个人都是自己命运的建筑师。

english: After the game, the king and the pawn go into the same box.
chinese: 棋局结束后，国王和小兵都回到同一个盒子。

english: Who goes slowly goes safely and goes far.
chinese: 走得稳，才走得远。

english: Between saying and doing, many a pair of shoes is worn out.
chinese: 从说到做，常常要走很长的路。

english: Hope is the last thing ever lost.
chinese: 希望，是最后才会失去的东西。

english: A closed mouth catches no flies.
chinese: 少说无益的话，能避开许多麻烦。

english: There is no road too long to the person who advances deliberately.
chinese: 对坚定前行的人来说，没有路会长得无法走完。

english: Tomorrow is another day.
chinese: 明天又是新的一天。
source: Traditional saying; popularized by Gone with the Wind

english: Shared joy is double joy; shared sorrow is half sorrow.
chinese: 快乐分享会加倍，忧愁分享会减半。

english: There is no bad weather, only bad clothing.
chinese: 没有坏天气，只有不合适的衣服。

english: Fear less, hope more; eat less, chew more.
chinese: 少些恐惧，多些希望；少些贪多，多些细品。

english: Those who wish to sing always find a song.
chinese: 真想歌唱的人，总能找到自己的歌。

english: A smooth road never made a skillful driver.
chinese: 太平坦的路，练不出高明的驾驶者。

english: Do not look where you fell, but where you slipped.
chinese: 别只盯着跌倒的地方，要找到真正让你失足的原因。

english: If you want to go fast, go alone; if you want to go far, go together.
chinese: 想走得快，就独自前行；想走得远，就结伴同行。

english: However long the night, the dawn will break.
chinese: 黑夜无论多长，黎明终会到来。

english: Wisdom is like a baobab tree; no one individual can embrace it.
chinese: 智慧像猴面包树，一个人无法独自环抱。

english: When there is no enemy within, the enemies outside cannot hurt you.
chinese: 当内心不再与自己为敌，外界便很难击垮你。

english: A little hope each day can fill the rivers to overflowing.
chinese: 每天积攒一点希望，终能汇成满溢的河流。

english: Rain does not fall on one roof alone.
chinese: 雨不会只落在一家的屋顶上。

english: A wise person never knows all; only fools know everything.
chinese: 智者从不认为自己无所不知，只有愚者才如此确信。

english: The sun does not forget a village just because it is small.
chinese: 村庄虽小，太阳也不会忘记照耀它。

english: If you heal the leg of a person, do not be surprised if they use it to run away.
chinese: 帮助别人之后，也要允许对方选择自己的道路。

english: A person who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
chinese: 移山的人，也是从搬走小石头开始。

english: Learning is a treasure that will follow its owner everywhere.
chinese: 学问是随身而行的珍宝。

english: Teachers open the door; you enter by yourself.
chinese: 师父领进门，修行在个人。

english: Be not afraid of growing slowly; be afraid only of standing still.
chinese: 不怕慢，只怕站。

english: A wise person adapts to circumstances as water shapes itself to the vessel.
chinese: 智者顺势而变，如水随器成形。

english: The best memory is not as good as a worn-out pen.
chinese: 好记性不如烂笔头。

english: One generation plants the trees; another gets the shade.
chinese: 前人栽树，后人乘凉。

english: A gem is not polished without rubbing, nor a person perfected without trials.
chinese: 玉不琢，不成器；人不经磨炼，难以成熟。

english: The palest ink is better than the best memory.
chinese: 最淡的墨水，也胜过最强的记忆。

english: A bad workman blames his tools.
chinese: 拙匠常怪工具差。

english: Actions speak louder than words.
chinese: 行动胜于空谈。

english: All good things must come to an end.
chinese: 再美好的事，也终有结束的时候。

english: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
chinese: 一分预防，胜过十分补救。

english: Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
chinese: 事情未成之前，不要过早乐观。

english: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
chinese: 不要把所有鸡蛋放在同一个篮子里。

english: If it isn't broken, don't fix it.
chinese: 没有坏，就别乱修。

english: Make hay while the sun shines.
chinese: 趁着晴天晒草；把握当下的好时机。

english: Necessity is the mother of invention.
chinese: 需要是发明之母。

english: Practice makes perfect.
chinese: 熟能生巧。

english: The early bird catches the worm.
chinese: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

english: The grass is always greener on the other side.
chinese: 别人的草地看起来总是更绿。

english: Where there's a will, there's a way.
chinese: 有志者，事竟成。

english: You reap what you sow.
chinese: 种什么因，得什么果。

english: Live and let live.
chinese: 自己好好生活，也让别人按自己的方式生活。

english: Let sleeping dogs lie.
chinese: 别去招惹已经平息的麻烦。

english: One good turn deserves another.
chinese: 善意值得用善意回应。

english: Honesty is the best policy.
chinese: 诚实是最好的处世原则。

english: Look before you leap.
chinese: 三思而后行。

english: Hope for the best; prepare for the worst.
chinese: 抱最好的希望，做最坏的准备。

english: A watched pot never boils.
chinese: 越焦急等待，时间越显得漫长。

english: Waste not, want not.
chinese: 不浪费，便不匮乏。

english: You cannot make an omelet without breaking eggs.
chinese: 想做成事情，就要接受必要的代价。

english: The proof of the pudding is in the eating.
chinese: 好不好，要经实践检验。

english: Hope is the thing with feathers.
chinese: 希望，是那有羽毛的东西。
source: Emily Dickinson, poem 'Hope is the thing with feathers'

english: Forever is composed of nows.
chinese: 永恒，是由一个个当下组成的。

english: If I can stop one heart from breaking, I shall not live in vain.
chinese: 若我能使一颗心免于破碎，我便不算虚度此生。
source: Emily Dickinson, poem 'If I can stop one heart from breaking'

english: I dwell in Possibility.
chinese: 我栖居于可能之中。
source: Emily Dickinson, poem 'I dwell in Possibility'

english: The heart wants what it wants.
chinese: 心所渴望的，自有它的理由。

english: I am the master of my fate; I am the captain of my soul.
chinese: 我是自己命运的主人，也是自己灵魂的船长。

english: My head is bloody, but unbowed.
chinese: 即使头破血流，我也绝不低头。

english: To strive, to seek, to find, and not to yield.
chinese: 去奋斗，去探索，去发现，永不屈服。

english: Come, my friends, 'tis not too late to seek a newer world.
chinese: 来吧，朋友们，追寻新世界永远不算太迟。

english: 'Tis better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.
chinese: 爱过而失去，也胜过从未爱过。

english: The old order changeth, yielding place to new.
chinese: 旧秩序终会改变，为新事物让路。
source: Alfred, Lord Tennyson, 'Idylls of the King'

english: I have promises to keep, and miles to go before I sleep.
chinese: 我还有承诺要履行，睡去之前还有很长的路。
source: Robert Frost, poem 'Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening'

english: The best way out is always through.
chinese: 走出困境最好的方式，就是穿过它。
source: Robert Frost, poem 'A Servant to Servants'

english: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I took the one less traveled by.
chinese: 林中两条路分岔，我选择了人迹更少的那一条。
source: Robert Frost, poem 'The Road Not Taken'

english: Nothing gold can stay.
chinese: 再珍贵的金色时光，也无法永远停留。
source: Robert Frost, poem 'Nothing Gold Can Stay'

english: In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: it goes on.
chinese: 用三个词概括我对人生的理解：它会继续。

english: Do I dare disturb the universe?
chinese: 我是否敢去撼动这个世界？
source: T. S. Eliot, poem 'The Love Song of J. Alfred Prufrock'

english: There is only the trying. The rest is not our business.
chinese: 我们能做的只有尽力，其余并非我们所能掌控。

english: For us, there is only the trying.
chinese: 对我们而言，最重要的只有尝试。

english: We shall not cease from exploration.
chinese: 我们不会停止探索。

english: This is the way the world ends: not with a bang but a whimper.
chinese: 世界就这样结束：不是轰然一响，而是一声呜咽。
source: T. S. Eliot, poem 'The Hollow Men'

english: Let everything happen to you: beauty and terror.
chinese: 让一切都在你身上发生：美，也包括恐惧。

english: Live the questions now.
chinese: 先活在问题之中。
source: Rainer Maria Rilke, Letters to a Young Poet

english: No feeling is final.
chinese: 没有一种感受会永远持续。

english: The only journey is the one within.
chinese: 真正的旅程，是走向自己的内心。

english: You must change your life.
chinese: 你必须改变自己的生活。
source: Rainer Maria Rilke, poem 'Archaic Torso of Apollo'

english: And now we welcome the new year, full of things that have never been.
chinese: 现在，让我们迎接新年，迎接那些从未发生过的事。

english: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
chinese: 告诉我，你准备怎样度过这仅有一次、狂野而珍贵的人生？

english: You do not have to be good.
chinese: 你不必时时证明自己足够好。

english: Pay attention. Be astonished. Tell about it.
chinese: 认真注视，保持惊叹，然后把它说出来。

english: Instructions for living a life: Pay attention. Be astonished. Tell about it.
chinese: 生活的说明书：认真注视，保持惊叹，然后讲述。

english: Keep some room in your heart for the unimaginable.
chinese: 在心里留一点空间，给那些不可想象的可能。

english: What will you do with your one wild and precious life?
chinese: 你要怎样度过这仅有一次、狂野而珍贵的人生？

english: There are a thousand ways to kneel and kiss the ground.
chinese: 俯身亲吻大地，有一千种方式。

english: What you seek is seeking you.
chinese: 你所寻找的，也正在寻找你。

english: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
chinese: 伤口，正是光进入你的地方。

english: Why do you stay in prison when the door is so wide open?
chinese: 门明明敞开着，你为何还留在牢笼里？

english: Raise your words, not your voice.
chinese: 提高你的思想和语言，而不是提高音量。

english: Let yourself be silently drawn by the strange pull of what you really love.
chinese: 让真正热爱的事物，以无声的力量牵引你前行。

english: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing, there is a field.
chinese: 在对错观念之外，有一片原野。

english: The breeze at dawn has secrets to tell you. Don't go back to sleep.
chinese: 黎明的微风带着秘密而来，别再沉睡。

english: Be melting snow. Wash yourself of yourself.
chinese: 像融雪一样，让执念从自身流走。

english: Only from the heart can you touch the sky.
chinese: 只有从心出发，才能触及天空。

english: I celebrate myself, and sing myself.
chinese: 我赞美自己，也歌唱自己。

english: Keep your face always toward the sunshine—and shadows will fall behind you.
chinese: 永远面向阳光，阴影自然落在身后。

english: I am large, I contain multitudes.
chinese: 我辽阔无边，我容纳万千。

english: Resist much, obey little.
chinese: 多一些质疑，少一些盲从。

english: Be curious, not judgmental.
chinese: 保持好奇，不急于评判。
source: Commonly attributed to Walt Whitman; popularized by Ted Lasso

english: The powerful play goes on, and you may contribute a verse.
chinese: 这场宏大的戏仍在继续，而你可以写下属于自己的一句诗。
source: Walt Whitman, poem 'O Me! O Life!'

english: I exist as I am, that is enough.
chinese: 我如我所是，这就已经足够。

english: Do anything, but let it produce joy.
chinese: 做你愿意做的事，但要让它生出喜悦。

english: It is not down in any map; true places never are.
chinese: 真正重要的地方，从来不在地图上。

english: I know not all that may be coming, but be it what it will, I'll go to it laughing.
chinese: 我不知道将来会发生什么，但无论发生什么，我都会笑着迎上去。

english: Call me Ishmael.
chinese: 叫我以实玛利吧。

english: There is wisdom that is woe; but there is a woe that is madness.
chinese: 有一种智慧伴随忧伤，也有一种忧伤走向疯狂。

english: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
chinese: 我们真正能决定的，是如何使用被给予的时间。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Fellowship of the Ring

english: Not all those who wander are lost.
chinese: 并非所有徘徊的人都迷失了方向。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, poem in The Fellowship of the Ring

english: Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
chinese: 即使最微小的人，也能改变未来的走向。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings

english: There is some good in this world, and it's worth fighting for.
chinese: 这个世界仍有美好，而它值得我们为之奋斗。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Two Towers; film adaptation wording

english: Courage is found in unlikely places.
chinese: 勇气常常出现在最意想不到的地方。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Fellowship of the Ring

english: Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens.
chinese: 道路变暗时就告别的人，谈不上忠诚。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Fellowship of the Ring

english: Deeds will not be less valiant because they are unpraised.
chinese: 即使无人赞美，勇敢的行动也不会因此失去价值。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Return of the King

english: The world is indeed full of peril, and in it there are many dark places; but still there is much that is fair.
chinese: 世界确实充满危险，也有许多黑暗角落；但其中依然有大量美好。
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Fellowship of the Ring

english: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
chinese: 沉溺梦想而忘记生活，并不是好事。
source: J. K. Rowling, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

english: Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.
chinese: 即使身处最黑暗的时刻，只要记得点亮一盏灯，也能找到幸福。
source: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban, film

english: It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
chinese: 真正显示我们是谁的，是我们的选择，而不是能力。
source: J. K. Rowling, Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

english: Things we lose have a way of coming back to us in the end.
chinese: 我们失去的东西，最终常会以某种方式回到身边。
source: J. K. Rowling, Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

english: Numbing the pain for a while will make it worse when you finally feel it.
chinese: 暂时麻痹痛苦，只会让它在真正到来时更难承受。
source: J. K. Rowling, Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

english: Differences of habit and language are nothing at all if our aims are identical and our hearts are open.
chinese: 只要目标相同、心胸开放，习惯和语言的差异根本不算什么。
source: J. K. Rowling, Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

english: We are only as strong as we are united, as weak as we are divided.
chinese: 团结时我们才强大，分裂时我们便脆弱。
source: J. K. Rowling, Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

english: It matters not what someone is born, but what they grow to be.
chinese: 重要的不是一个人生来是什么，而是他最终成长为什么。
source: J. K. Rowling, Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

english: Tomorrow is always fresh, with no mistakes in it yet.
chinese: 明天永远崭新，还没有犯过任何错误。
source: L. M. Montgomery, Anne of Green Gables

english: It's been my experience that you can nearly always enjoy things if you make up your mind firmly that you will.
chinese: 我的经验是，只要真心决定去享受，几乎任何事情都能找到乐趣。
source: L. M. Montgomery, Anne of Green Gables

english: Life is worth living as long as there's a laugh in it.
chinese: 只要生活中还有笑声，人生就值得继续。
source: L. M. Montgomery, Anne of Green Gables

english: Isn't it nice to think that tomorrow is a new day with no mistakes in it yet?
chinese: 想到明天是全新的一天、还没有任何错误，不是很美好吗？
source: L. M. Montgomery, Anne of Green Gables

english: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.
chinese: 没有什么魅力能胜过一颗温柔的心。

english: Think only of the past as its remembrance gives you pleasure.
chinese: 回忆过去时，只保留那些能带来温暖的部分。

english: There is no enjoyment like reading.
chinese: 没有什么乐趣能与阅读相比。

english: We are all fools in love.
chinese: 在爱情里，我们都难免有些傻气。

english: To be fond of dancing was a certain step towards falling in love.
chinese: 喜欢跳舞，往往是走向爱情的一步。

english: It isn't what we say or think that defines us, but what we do.
chinese: 定义我们的，不是所说所想，而是实际行动。
source: Jane Austen, Sense and Sensibility, commonly cited paraphrase

english: No one is useless in this world who lightens the burdens of another.
chinese: 能减轻别人负担的人，在这个世界上绝不是无用之人。

english: There are dark shadows on the earth, but its lights are stronger in the contrast.
chinese: 世上虽有黑暗阴影，但正因如此，光才更显明亮。

english: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
chinese: 这是最好的时代，也是最坏的时代。
source: Charles Dickens, A Tale of Two Cities

english: A loving heart is the truest wisdom.
chinese: 一颗有爱的心，才是真正的智慧。

english: Never close your lips to those whom you have already opened your heart.
chinese: 既然已经向一个人敞开心扉，就不要再用沉默将他拒之门外。

english: Have a heart that never hardens, and a temper that never tires.
chinese: 愿你有一颗永不冷硬的心，也有一份永不厌倦的耐心。

english: The pain of parting is nothing to the joy of meeting again.
chinese: 离别的痛苦，比不上重逢的喜悦。

english: We need never be ashamed of our tears.
chinese: 我们永远不必为眼泪感到羞耻。

english: Take nothing on its looks; take everything on evidence.
chinese: 不要只凭外表判断，要依据事实。

english: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
chinese: 无论灵魂由什么构成，我和他的灵魂都是一样的。

english: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me.
chinese: 我不是鸟，也没有罗网能够困住我。

english: Life appears to me too short to be spent in nursing animosity.
chinese: 人生太短，不该浪费在滋养怨恨上。

english: I would always rather be happy than dignified.
chinese: 比起维持体面，我更愿意选择幸福。

english: The soul, fortunately, has an interpreter—often an unconscious but still a faithful interpreter—in the eye.
chinese: 幸运的是，灵魂有一个译者，那就是眼睛。

english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
chinese: 当心吧，因为我无所畏惧，所以拥有力量。

english: Nothing is so painful to the human mind as a great and sudden change.
chinese: 对人的心灵而言，没有什么比巨大而突然的变化更痛苦。

english: The world was to me a secret which I desired to divine.
chinese: 世界对我来说是一个渴望解开的秘密。

english: Life, although it may only be an accumulation of anguish, is dear to me.
chinese: 生命即使积累着痛苦，对我依然珍贵。

english: There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.
chinese: 世事本无绝对好坏，许多感受来自我们的看法。

english: To thine own self be true.
chinese: 忠于你自己。

english: We know what we are, but know not what we may be.
chinese: 我们知道自己现在是谁，却不知道未来能成为谁。

english: The readiness is all.
chinese: 真正重要的，是做好准备。

english: Our doubts are traitors.
chinese: 怀疑常常会背叛我们。

english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
chinese: 问题不在命运，而在我们自己。

english: Cowards die many times before their deaths; the valiant never taste of death but once.
chinese: 懦夫在真正死去前已死过多次，勇者只经历一次死亡。

english: What's past is prologue.
chinese: 过去只是序章。

english: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
chinese: 我们正是由梦构成的。

english: All the world's a stage.
chinese: 整个世界就是一座舞台。
source: William Shakespeare, As You Like It

english: Sweet are the uses of adversity.
chinese: 逆境也有它甘甜的用处。
source: William Shakespeare, As You Like It

english: Love all, trust a few, do wrong to none.
chinese: 爱所有人，信任少数人，不伤害任何人。
source: William Shakespeare, All's Well That Ends Well

english: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
chinese: 我们唯一需要恐惧的，就是恐惧本身。
source: Franklin D. Roosevelt, first inaugural address, 1933

english: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
chinese: 未来属于那些相信梦想之美的人。

english: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
chinese: 未经你的允许，没有人能让你觉得低人一等。
source: Eleanor Roosevelt, This Is My Story

english: Do one thing every day that scares you.
chinese: 每天做一件让自己有点害怕的事。

english: It is better to light a candle than curse the darkness.
chinese: 与其诅咒黑暗，不如点亮一支蜡烛。
source: Proverb popularized by Eleanor Roosevelt and others

english: Great minds discuss ideas; average minds discuss events; small minds discuss people.
chinese: 伟大的人讨论思想，普通的人讨论事件，狭隘的人议论他人。

english: You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
chinese: 你必须去做那件你以为自己做不到的事。
source: Eleanor Roosevelt, You Learn by Living

english: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
chinese: 困难之中，往往藏着机会。

english: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
chinese: 人生像骑自行车；想保持平衡，就要继续前进。
source: Albert Einstein, letter to his son Eduard, 1930

english: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
chinese: 想象力比知识更重要。

english: Try not to become a person of success, but rather try to become a person of value.
chinese: 不要只追求成为成功的人，更要努力成为有价值的人。

english: A person who never made a mistake never tried anything new.
chinese: 从不犯错的人，通常也从未尝试新事物。

english: We cannot solve our problems with the same thinking we used when we created them.
chinese: 我们不能用制造问题时的旧思维，去解决这些问题。

english: The important thing is not to stop questioning.
chinese: 重要的是永远不要停止提问。

english: Anyone who has never made a mistake has never tried anything new.
chinese: 一个从未犯错的人，也很可能从未尝试过新事物。

english: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
chinese: 不要只追求成功，更要努力创造价值。

english: The measure of intelligence is the ability to change.
chinese: 智慧的重要尺度，是改变自己的能力。

english: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow.
chinese: 向昨天学习，活在今天，对明天怀抱希望。

english: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
chinese: 成功并非终点，失败也非末日；重要的是继续前行的勇气。

english: If you're going through hell, keep going.
chinese: 如果你正穿过地狱，那就继续走。

english: Never, never, never give in.
chinese: 永远，永远，永远不要屈服。
source: Winston Churchill, Harrow School speech, 1941; commonly shortened

english: Attitude is a little thing that makes a big difference.
chinese: 态度虽小，却能造成巨大的不同。

english: Kites rise highest against the wind—not with it.
chinese: 风筝逆风而上，而不是顺风。

english: We make a living by what we get, but we make a life by what we give.
chinese: 所得让我们谋生，付出让我们真正生活。

english: History will be kind to me, for I intend to write it.
chinese: 历史会善待我，因为我打算亲自书写它。

english: It always seems impossible until it's done.
chinese: 事情在完成之前，总显得不可能。

english: I never lose. I either win or learn.
chinese: 我从不失败；我不是赢，就是学习。

english: After climbing a great hill, one only finds that there are many more hills to climb.
chinese: 翻过一座高山后，才发现前面还有更多山峰。
source: Nelson Mandela, Long Walk to Freedom

english: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
chinese: 人生最大的荣耀，不在从不跌倒，而在每次跌倒后都能站起。
source: Often attributed to Nelson Mandela; earlier variants exist

english: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
chinese: 教育是你可以用来改变世界的最强大武器。

english: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.
chinese: 勇气不是没有恐惧，而是战胜恐惧。
source: Nelson Mandela, Long Walk to Freedom

english: May your choices reflect your hopes, not your fears.
chinese: 愿你的选择反映希望，而不是恐惧。

english: Our deepest fear is not that we are inadequate.
chinese: 我们最深的恐惧，并不是自己不够好。
source: Marianne Williamson, A Return to Love

english: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that.
chinese: 黑暗无法驱散黑暗，只有光可以。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., Strength to Love

english: Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.
chinese: 仇恨无法驱散仇恨，只有爱可以。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., Strength to Love

english: The time is always right to do what is right.
chinese: 做正确的事，永远都是恰当的时机。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., commonly cited

english: Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.
chinese: 信念就是即使看不见整段楼梯，也愿意迈出第一步。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., commonly attributed

english: We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope.
chinese: 我们必须接受有限的失望，却绝不能失去无限的希望。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., In My Own Words

english: Life's most persistent and urgent question is: What are you doing for others?
chinese: 人生最持久、最迫切的问题是：你正在为别人做什么？

english: If I cannot do great things, I can do small things in a great way.
chinese: 如果做不了伟大的事，我也可以用伟大的方式做好小事。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., commonly attributed

english: We may have all come on different ships, but we're in the same boat now.
chinese: 我们也许乘着不同的船而来，但现在都在同一条船上。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., commonly attributed

english: The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends toward justice.
chinese: 道德宇宙的弧线虽然漫长，却终将弯向正义。
source: Martin Luther King Jr., sermon, adapting Theodore Parker

english: Ask not what your country can do for you—ask what you can do for your country.
chinese: 不要问国家能为你做什么，要问你能为国家做什么。

english: Every accomplishment starts with the decision to try.
chinese: 每一项成就，都始于尝试的决定。
source: Commonly attributed to John F. Kennedy

english: One person can make a difference, and everyone should try.
chinese: 一个人也能带来改变，而每个人都应该尝试。
source: Commonly attributed to John F. Kennedy

english: Efforts and courage are not enough without purpose and direction.
chinese: 没有目标和方向，努力与勇气仍然不够。

english: We choose to go to the Moon.
chinese: 我们选择登上月球。
source: John F. Kennedy, Rice University speech, 1962

english: Change is the law of life.
chinese: 改变是生命的法则。

english: Do not pray for easy lives. Pray to be stronger men.
chinese: 不要祈求轻松的人生，要祈求自己变得更强。

english: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
chinese: 实现明天的唯一限制，是我们今天的怀疑。

english: When you reach the end of your rope, tie a knot and hang on.
chinese: 当你抓到绳子的尽头，就打个结，坚持住。
source: Commonly attributed to Franklin D. Roosevelt

english: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
chinese: 在你所在之处，用你拥有的条件，做你能做的事。
source: Theodore Roosevelt, quoting Squire Bill Widener

english: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
chinese: 相信自己能做到，你就已经走了一半。

english: People ask the difference between a leader and a boss. The leader leads, and the boss drives.
chinese: 领袖带领人前进，老板只会驱使人行动。

english: Keep your eyes on the stars, and your feet on the ground.
chinese: 仰望星空，也要脚踏实地。

english: Old age is like everything else. To make a success of it, you've got to start young.
chinese: 变老也和其他事情一样；想把它过好，就要从年轻时开始准备。

english: Far and away the best prize that life offers is the chance to work hard at work worth doing.
chinese: 人生最好的奖赏，是有机会为值得的事情努力。

english: It is only through labor and painful effort that we move on to better things.
chinese: 只有通过劳动和艰苦努力，我们才能走向更好的未来。

english: Speak softly and carry a big stick.
chinese: 说话温和，同时保有实力。

english: The credit belongs to the man who is actually in the arena.
chinese: 荣誉属于真正站在竞技场里的人。

english: Do not judge me by my successes; judge me by how many times I fell down and got back up again.
chinese: 不要用成功来评判我，要看我跌倒多少次又重新站起。

english: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
chinese: 成为你希望在世界上看到的改变。
source: Commonly attributed to Mahatma Gandhi; paraphrase of his ideas

english: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
chinese: 像明天就会离去那样生活，像永远活着那样学习。

english: The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
chinese: 弱者无法宽恕；宽恕是强者的品质。

english: Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
chinese: 力量不只来自体能，更来自不可征服的意志。

english: An eye for an eye only ends up making the whole world blind.
chinese: 以眼还眼，最终只会让全世界失明。

english: Happiness is when what you think, what you say, and what you do are in harmony.
chinese: 幸福，是思想、言语与行动彼此一致。

english: The future depends on what you do today.
chinese: 未来取决于你今天所做的事。

english: In a gentle way, you can shake the world.
chinese: 以温和的方式，也能撼动世界。

english: Freedom is not worth having if it does not include the freedom to make mistakes.
chinese: 若不包括犯错的自由，自由便不值得拥有。

english: First they ignore you, then they laugh at you, then they fight you, then you win.
chinese: 起初他们忽视你，随后嘲笑你、反对你，最后你赢得胜利。
source: Commonly attributed to Gandhi; attribution disputed

english: You may never know what results come of your actions, but if you do nothing, there will be no result.
chinese: 你也许永远不知道行动会带来什么结果，但若什么都不做，就一定没有结果。

english: Turn your wounds into wisdom.
chinese: 把伤口变成智慧。

english: Doing the best at this moment puts you in the best place for the next moment.
chinese: 此刻做到最好，会把你带到下一个更好的位置。

english: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
chinese: 你能踏上的最大冒险，就是活出梦想中的人生。

english: You get in life what you have the courage to ask for.
chinese: 人生会给予你那些你有勇气开口争取的东西。

english: Failure is another stepping stone to greatness.
chinese: 失败只是通往卓越的另一块垫脚石。

english: Create the highest, grandest vision possible for your life.
chinese: 为自己的人生描绘尽可能高远的愿景。

english: When they go low, we go high.
chinese: 当别人选择低处，我们选择更高的原则。
source: Michelle Obama, Democratic National Convention speech, 2016

english: Success isn't about how much money you make; it's about the difference you make in people's lives.
chinese: 成功不在于赚多少钱，而在于你为别人的生活带来多大改变。

english: Your story is what you have, what you will always have.
chinese: 你的故事属于你，也将永远伴随你。

english: There is no magic to achievement. It's really about hard work, choices, and persistence.
chinese: 成就没有魔法，它来自努力、选择和坚持。

english: Am I good enough? Yes, I am.
chinese: 我够好吗？是的，我够好。

english: One voice can change a room.
chinese: 一个声音可以改变整个房间。

english: Change will not come if we wait for some other person or some other time.
chinese: 如果只等待别人或另一个时机，改变永远不会到来。

english: We are the ones we've been waiting for.
chinese: 我们一直等待的人，其实就是我们自己。
source: Barack Obama, campaign speech, adapting June Jordan

english: The future rewards those who press on.
chinese: 未来会奖励那些继续前行的人。

english: Yes, we can.
chinese: 是的，我们能做到。

english: If you're walking down the right path and you're willing to keep walking, eventually you'll make progress.
chinese: 只要走在正确的路上并愿意坚持，终会取得进展。

english: We did not come to fear the future. We came here to shape it.
chinese: 我们来到这里，不是为了害怕未来，而是为了塑造未来。

english: Focusing your life solely on making a buck shows a poverty of ambition.
chinese: 若人生只专注于赚钱，反而显示了志向的贫乏。

english: The best way to not feel hopeless is to get up and do something.
chinese: 摆脱绝望最好的办法，就是起身去做点什么。

english: Whatever you are, be a good one.
chinese: 无论你做什么，都努力把它做好。

english: I am a slow walker, but I never walk back.
chinese: 我走得慢，但我从不后退。

english: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any other.
chinese: 请始终记住：你成功的决心，比其他任何因素都重要。

english: Give me six hours to chop down a tree and I will spend the first four sharpening the axe.
chinese: 给我六小时砍树，我会先用四小时磨斧。

english: I do the very best I know how—the very best I can.
chinese: 我会用自己所知、所能做到的最好方式去做。

english: Nearly all people can stand adversity, but if you want to test a person's character, give them power.
chinese: 多数人能经受逆境；若想检验一个人的品格，就给他权力。
source: Often attributed to Abraham Lincoln; likely later formulation

english: The best way to predict your future is to create it.
chinese: 预测未来最好的方式，是亲手创造它。
source: Often attributed to Peter Drucker and Abraham Lincoln

english: Those who dare to fail miserably can achieve greatly.
chinese: 敢于经历惨痛失败的人，也可能取得伟大成就。

english: Only those who dare to fail greatly can ever achieve greatly.
chinese: 只有敢于大败的人，才可能取得大成。

english: Some people see things as they are and say why. I dream things that never were and say why not.
chinese: 有人看见现实并追问为什么；我梦想从未存在的事物，并追问为什么不。
source: Robert F. Kennedy, speech, adapting George Bernard Shaw

english: Each time a person stands up for an ideal, they send forth a tiny ripple of hope.
chinese: 每当一个人为理想挺身而出，就会激起一圈希望的涟漪。
source: Robert F. Kennedy, Day of Affirmation Address, 1966

english: May the Force be with you.
chinese: 愿原力与你同在。

english: Do. Or do not. There is no try.
chinese: 要么做，要么不做；不要只停留在“试试看”。
source: Yoda, Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back

english: Your focus determines your reality.
chinese: 你的专注，决定你看到的现实。
source: Qui-Gon Jinn, Star Wars: The Phantom Menace

english: The Force will be with you. Always.
chinese: 原力会永远与你同在。

english: Never tell me the odds.
chinese: 别告诉我胜算有多小。
source: Han Solo, Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back

english: In my experience, there's no such thing as luck.
chinese: 依我的经验，所谓运气并不存在。
source: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Star Wars: A New Hope

english: Fear is the path to the dark side.
chinese: 恐惧是通往黑暗面的道路。
source: Yoda, Star Wars: The Phantom Menace

english: The greatest teacher, failure is.
chinese: 失败，是最伟大的老师。
source: Yoda, Star Wars: The Last Jedi

english: No one's ever really gone.
chinese: 真正重要的人，从未彻底离开。
source: Luke Skywalker, Star Wars: The Last Jedi

english: Chewie, we're home.
chinese: 楚巴卡，我们回家了。
source: Han Solo, Star Wars: The Force Awakens

english: Just keep swimming.
chinese: 继续游，别停下。

english: When life gets you down, you know what you gotta do? Just keep swimming.
chinese: 生活让你低落时，你要做的就是继续向前。

english: To infinity and beyond!
chinese: 飞向无限，超越一切！

english: You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
chinese: 你比自己相信的更勇敢，比看起来更坚强，也比想象中更聪明。
source: Christopher Robin, commonly associated with Winnie-the-Pooh adaptations

english: The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all.
chinese: 在逆境中盛开的花，最珍贵也最美丽。

english: The past can hurt. But you can either run from it or learn from it.
chinese: 过去会伤人；你可以逃避，也可以从中学习。

english: Remember who you are.
chinese: 记住你是谁。

english: Hakuna Matata.
chinese: 别担心，轻松生活。
source: The Lion King; Swahili phrase meaning 'no worries'

english: Oh yes, the past can hurt.
chinese: 是的，过去确实会让人受伤。

english: The very things that hold you down are going to lift you up.
chinese: 曾经压住你的东西，也可能成为托起你的力量。

english: Adventure is out there!
chinese: 冒险就在前方！

english: Thanks for the adventure—now go have a new one.
chinese: 谢谢你陪我经历这场冒险，现在去开启新的旅程吧。

english: Sometimes the right path is not the easiest one.
chinese: 正确的路，有时并不是最容易的路。

english: Our fate lives within us. You only have to be brave enough to see it.
chinese: 命运就在我们心里，你只需要勇敢地看见它。

english: If you focus on what you left behind, you will never see what lies ahead.
chinese: 若只盯着失去的东西，就看不见前方的可能。

english: Anyone can cook.
chinese: 任何人都可以创造美好。

english: The only thing predictable about life is its unpredictability.
chinese: 人生唯一可以预料的，就是它的不可预料。

english: Not everyone can become a great artist, but a great artist can come from anywhere.
chinese: 不是每个人都能成为伟大的艺术家，但伟大的艺术家可能来自任何地方。

english: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift.
chinese: 昨天已成历史，明天仍是谜，而今天是一份礼物。

english: There is no secret ingredient.
chinese: 真正的秘诀，就是相信本来的自己。

english: Your story may not have such a happy beginning, but that doesn't make you who you are.
chinese: 你的故事开头也许并不幸福，但它并不能定义你是谁。

english: Anything is possible when you have inner peace.
chinese: 当内心平静时，一切皆有可能。

english: The present is a gift.
chinese: 当下，就是一份礼物。
source: Kung Fu Panda, wordplay in dialogue

english: You must believe.
chinese: 你必须相信。

english: I never look back, darling. It distracts from the now.
chinese: 我从不回头，亲爱的；那会让我错过当下。

english: Luck favors the prepared.
chinese: 好运眷顾有准备的人。

english: When everyone is super, no one will be.
chinese: 当所有人都“特别”时，也就没人真正特别。

english: You control your destiny—you don't need magic to do it.
chinese: 命运掌握在你自己手中，不需要魔法。

english: Let it go.
chinese: 放下吧。

english: Some people are worth melting for.
chinese: 有些人，值得你为他们融化自己。

english: Do the next right thing.
chinese: 做好眼前下一件正确的事。

english: Fear can't be trusted.
chinese: 恐惧不值得完全相信。

english: Show yourself.
chinese: 勇敢展现真正的自己。

english: The cold never bothered me anyway.
chinese: 寒冷从未真正困扰过我。

english: How lucky am I to have something that makes saying goodbye so hard.
chinese: 能够拥有一段让告别如此艰难的关系，我是多么幸运。

english: Sometimes the smallest things take up the most room in your heart.
chinese: 有时最微小的事物，会占据心中最大的空间。

english: A day without a friend is like a pot without a single drop of honey.
chinese: 没有朋友的一天，就像蜂蜜罐里一滴蜜也没有。

english: Promise me you'll always remember: you're braver than you believe.
chinese: 答应我，永远记住：你比自己相信的更勇敢。

english: The things that make me different are the things that make me.
chinese: 正是那些与众不同之处，构成了真正的我。

english: Today is a good day to try.
chinese: 今天是适合尝试的一天。
source: The Hunchback of Notre Dame, Disney

english: Keep moving forward.
chinese: 继续向前。

english: Around here, however, we don't look backwards for very long.
chinese: 在这里，我们不会长久停留在过去。
source: Meet the Robinsons, quoting Walt Disney

english: You don't have time to be timid. You must be bold and daring.
chinese: 你没有时间畏缩，必须勇敢而大胆。

english: Think of the one thing you've always wanted. Now find it in your mind's eye and feel it in your heart.
chinese: 想一件你一直渴望的事，让它出现在脑海，也落在心里。

english: Even miracles take a little time.
chinese: 即使奇迹，也需要一点时间。

english: Have courage and be kind.
chinese: 要勇敢，也要善良。

english: Where there is kindness, there is goodness; where there is goodness, there is magic.
chinese: 有善意的地方就有美好，有美好的地方就有魔法。

english: A dream is a wish your heart makes.
chinese: 梦想，是心灵许下的愿望。

english: The only way to get what you want in this world is through hard work.
chinese: 想在这个世界得到真正想要的东西，离不开努力。
source: Tiana, The Princess and the Frog

english: You got to dig a little deeper.
chinese: 你得再往内心深处挖一点。

english: The evening star is shining bright. So make a wish and hold on tight.
chinese: 晚星正明亮，许下愿望，并牢牢守住它。

english: Sometimes our strengths lie beneath the surface.
chinese: 有时，我们的力量藏在表面之下。

english: The call isn't out there at all. It's inside me.
chinese: 真正的召唤不在远方，它就在我心里。

english: Know who you are.
chinese: 认识真正的自己。

english: If I go, there's just no telling how far I'll go.
chinese: 只要出发，就没人知道我能走多远。

english: I am Moana.
chinese: 我就是莫阿娜。

english: A true hero isn't measured by the size of his strength, but by the strength of his heart.
chinese: 真正的英雄，不看力量有多大，而看内心有多强。

english: Giving up is for rookies.
chinese: 放弃是新手才做的事。

english: Sometimes it is the people no one imagines anything of who do the things that no one can imagine.
chinese: 有时，正是那些不被看好的人，完成了无人能想象的事。

english: Why do we fall? So we can learn to pick ourselves up.
chinese: 我们为何跌倒？为了学会重新站起来。

english: It's not who I am underneath, but what I do that defines me.
chinese: 定义我的，不是内心自称是谁，而是我实际做了什么。

english: A hero can be anyone.
chinese: 任何人都可以成为英雄。

english: The night is darkest just before the dawn.
chinese: 黎明前的夜最黑。

english: You either die a hero, or you live long enough to see yourself become the villain.
chinese: 你要么以英雄之名离去，要么活得够久，看着自己成为反派。

english: There's some good in this world, Mr. Frodo, and it's worth fighting for.
chinese: 这个世界仍有美好，弗罗多先生，而它值得我们为之奋斗。
source: Sam, The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

english: I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.
chinese: 我宁愿与你共度一生，也不愿独自面对世间所有岁月。
source: Arwen, The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

english: Carpe diem. Seize the day, boys.
chinese: 及时行乐。孩子们，抓住今天。

english: No matter what anybody tells you, words and ideas can change the world.
chinese: 无论别人怎么说，文字与思想都能改变世界。

english: You are here—life exists, and identity; that the powerful play goes on, and you may contribute a verse.
chinese: 你在这里，生命存在，自我存在；宏大的戏继续，而你可以写下属于自己的诗句。
source: Dead Poets Society, quoting Walt Whitman

english: Medicine, law, business, engineering—these are noble pursuits. But poetry, beauty, romance, love—these are what we stay alive for.
chinese: 医学、法律、商业、工程都很高尚；但诗、美、浪漫与爱，才是我们活着的意义。

english: Get busy living, or get busy dying.
chinese: 要么忙着活，要么忙着死。

english: Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
chinese: 希望是好东西，也许是世上最好的东西。

english: Remember, Red, hope is a good thing.
chinese: 记住，瑞德，希望是一件好事。

english: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
chinese: 恐惧能囚禁你，希望能让你自由。

english: Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.
chinese: 生活走得很快；若不偶尔停下来看看，你可能会错过它。

english: Just because someone stumbles and loses their path, doesn't mean they're lost forever.
chinese: 一个人偶尔跌倒、迷路，并不代表他永远失去了方向。
source: Professor X, X-Men: Days of Future Past

english: Peace was never an option.
chinese: 和平从来不是唯一选项。

english: With great power comes great responsibility.
chinese: 能力越大，责任越大。
source: Spider-Man; maxim associated with Uncle Ben

english: Anyone can wear the mask.
chinese: 任何人都可以戴上面具，成为英雄。

english: It's a leap of faith.
chinese: 这需要一次信念的飞跃。

english: No matter how buried it gets, or lost you feel, you must promise me that you will hold on to hope.
chinese: 无论希望被埋得多深、你多么迷失，都要答应我坚持住。

english: Part of the journey is the end.
chinese: 旅程的一部分，就是学会面对终点。

english: Whatever it takes.
chinese: 无论付出什么代价。

english: I can do this all day.
chinese: 我可以坚持一整天。

english: We never lose our demons. We only learn to live above them.
chinese: 我们无法彻底失去心魔，只能学会不再被它控制。

english: It's not about you.
chinese: 这一切不只关乎你自己。

english: Wakanda forever!
chinese: 瓦坎达万岁！

english: In times of crisis, the wise build bridges, while the foolish build barriers.
chinese: 危机中，智者建桥，愚者筑墙。

english: Death is not the end. It's more of a stepping-off point.
chinese: 死亡并非终点，更像是迈向下一段旅程的起点。

english: We are Groot.
chinese: 我们是格鲁特。

english: I have lived most of my life surrounded by my enemies. I would be grateful to die surrounded by my friends.
chinese: 我一生大多被敌人包围；若能在朋友身边离去，我会心怀感激。

english: We accept the love we think we deserve.
chinese: 我们接受的爱，往往是我们以为自己配得上的爱。
source: Stephen Chbosky, The Perks of Being a Wallflower

english: And in that moment, I swear we were infinite.
chinese: 在那一刻，我发誓我们是无限的。
source: The Perks of Being a Wallflower

english: It's only after we've lost everything that we're free to do anything.
chinese: 只有当失去一切后，我们才可能获得做任何事的自由。

english: Every man dies, not every man really lives.
chinese: 人人都会死，但并非人人真正活过。

english: What we do in life echoes in eternity.
chinese: 我们此生所做的一切，会在永恒中回响。

english: Are you not entertained?
chinese: 你们还不满意吗？

english: Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer.
chinese: 亲近朋友，更要了解对手。
source: Michael Corleone, The Godfather Part II

english: Think different.
chinese: 不同凡想。

english: Just do it.
chinese: 尽管去做。

english: Impossible is nothing.
chinese: 没有什么不可能。

english: Because you're worth it.
chinese: 因为你值得。

english: Keep calm and carry on.
chinese: 保持冷静，继续前行。

english: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
chinese: 求知若饥，虚心若愚。
source: Stewart Brand; popularized by Steve Jobs, Stanford speech, 2005

english: One more thing.
chinese: 还有一件事。
source: Phrase associated with Steve Jobs presentations

english: Move fast and break things.
chinese: 快速行动，勇于打破旧框架。

english: Done is better than perfect.
chinese: 完成胜过完美。
source: Modern productivity maxim, associated with Facebook

english: Ideas are easy. Execution is everything.
chinese: 想法容易，执行决定一切。

english: Fail fast, learn faster.
chinese: 快速试错，更快学习。

english: Start before you're ready.
chinese: 在完全准备好之前就开始。

english: Progress, not perfection.
chinese: 追求进步，不必苛求完美。

english: One day or day one. You decide.
chinese: 是“总有一天”，还是“从第一天开始”，由你决定。

english: Dream big. Start small. Act now.
chinese: 梦想要大，起步要小，行动要快。

english: Work smarter, not harder.
chinese: 更聪明地工作，而不只是更辛苦地工作。

english: What gets measured gets managed.
chinese: 被衡量的事情，才更容易被管理。
source: Management maxim, often attributed to Peter Drucker

english: Culture eats strategy for breakfast.
chinese: 文化会在早餐时吃掉战略。
source: Management saying, commonly attributed to Peter Drucker

english: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
chinese: 预测未来最好的方式，是创造未来。
source: Commonly attributed to Peter Drucker and others

english: Plans are nothing; planning is everything.
chinese: 计划本身有限，规划的过程才最重要。

english: If you want something new, you have to stop doing something old.
chinese: 想获得新结果，就要停止某些旧做法。

english: Management is doing things right; leadership is doing the right things.
chinese: 管理是把事情做对，领导是做对的事情。
source: Commonly attributed to Peter Drucker and Warren Bennis

english: There is nothing so useless as doing efficiently that which should not be done at all.
chinese: 把根本不该做的事高效完成，是最无用的努力。

english: The greatest danger in times of turbulence is to act with yesterday's logic.
chinese: 动荡时期最大的危险，是仍用昨天的逻辑行动。

english: You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
chinese: 创造力不会被用完；越使用，反而越丰富。

english: Do the best you can until you know better. Then when you know better, do better.
chinese: 在懂得更多以前，尽力做到最好；懂得更多之后，就做得更好。

english: Nothing will work unless you do.
chinese: 除非你行动，否则没有什么会自动奏效。

english: If you don't like something, change it. If you can't change it, change your attitude.
chinese: 若不喜欢现状，就改变它；若无法改变，就调整自己的态度。

english: We may encounter many defeats, but we must not be defeated.
chinese: 我们也许会遭遇许多失败，但绝不能被失败击垮。

english: Try to be a rainbow in someone's cloud.
chinese: 努力成为别人乌云中的一道彩虹。

english: Courage is the most important of all the virtues.
chinese: 勇气是所有美德中最重要的一项。

english: People will forget what you said, but they will never forget how you made them feel.
chinese: 人们也许会忘记你说过什么，却不会忘记你带给他们的感受。
source: Commonly attributed to Maya Angelou; wording has earlier precedents

english: If one is lucky, a solitary fantasy can totally transform one million realities.
chinese: 幸运时，一个人的想象，也能改变千万人的现实。

english: Success is liking yourself, liking what you do, and liking how you do it.
chinese: 成功，是喜欢自己、喜欢所做的事，也喜欢做事的方式。

english: You can't stop the waves, but you can learn to surf.
chinese: 你无法阻止海浪，但可以学会冲浪。
source: Jon Kabat-Zinn, Wherever You Go, There You Are

english: Wherever you go, there you are.
chinese: 无论走到哪里，你都要与自己相处。
source: Jon Kabat-Zinn, book title and mindfulness saying

english: The little things? The little moments? They aren't little.
chinese: 那些小事、那些片刻，其实一点也不小。

english: As long as you are breathing, there is more right with you than wrong with you.
chinese: 只要你还在呼吸，你身上正确的部分就比错误的部分更多。

english: Mindfulness means being awake.
chinese: 正念，就是清醒地活着。

english: You are the sky. Everything else is just the weather.
chinese: 你是天空，其余一切只是天气。

english: Nothing ever goes away until it has taught us what we need to know.
chinese: 一件事不会真正离开，直到它教会我们该学的东西。

english: Start where you are.
chinese: 从你现在所在的地方开始。

english: Fear is a natural reaction to moving closer to the truth.
chinese: 越接近真实，恐惧越可能自然出现。

english: Compassion is not a relationship between the healer and the wounded.
chinese: 慈悲不是治愈者与伤者之间高低分明的关系。

english: The most difficult times for many of us are the ones we give ourselves.
chinese: 许多人最艰难的时刻，往往来自自己对自己的苛待。

english: No mud, no lotus.
chinese: 没有淤泥，就没有莲花。
source: Thích Nhất Hạnh, book title and teaching

english: Smile, breathe, and go slowly.
chinese: 微笑，呼吸，慢慢前行。

english: Because you are alive, everything is possible.
chinese: 因为你还活着，一切皆有可能。

english: The present moment is filled with joy and happiness.
chinese: 当下本身就充满喜悦与幸福。

english: Walk as if you are kissing the Earth with your feet.
chinese: 行走时，仿佛双脚正在亲吻大地。

english: The way out is in.
chinese: 向外寻找出口之前，先回到内心。

english: Understanding is love's other name.
chinese: 理解，是爱的另一个名字。

english: There is no way to happiness—happiness is the way.
chinese: 通往幸福的路并不存在；幸福本身就是道路。

english: Breathing in, I calm body and mind.
chinese: 吸气时，我让身心安定。

english: The present moment contains past and future.
chinese: 当下同时容纳过去与未来。

english: You have power over your mind—not outside events.
chinese: 你能掌控的是自己的心，而不是外界事件。

english: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
chinese: 人生的幸福，取决于思想的质量。

english: Waste no more time arguing what a good person should be. Be one.
chinese: 别再争论好人应当是什么样，直接成为那样的人。

english: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
chinese: 阻碍行动的事，反而推动行动；挡路之物，最终成为道路。

english: If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
chinese: 不正确的事不要做，不真实的话不要说。

english: Choose not to be harmed—and you won't feel harmed.
chinese: 选择不把它视为伤害，你便不会被它困住。

english: The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.
chinese: 灵魂会染上思想的颜色。

english: Very little is needed to make a happy life.
chinese: 幸福人生真正需要的东西，其实很少。

english: Receive without pride, let go without attachment.
chinese: 得到时不骄傲，放下时不执着。

english: Confine yourself to the present.
chinese: 把自己安顿在当下。

english: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
chinese: 我们在想象中遭受的痛苦，往往多于现实。

english: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
chinese: 所谓幸运，就是准备遇上机会。

english: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
chinese: 困难磨炼心智，正如劳动锻炼身体。

english: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
chinese: 立刻开始生活，把每一天都当成一段独立的人生。

english: While we wait for life, life passes.
chinese: 当我们等待生活开始时，生活已经流逝。

english: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste much of it.
chinese: 不是生命太短，而是我们浪费了太多时间。
source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life

english: No person is more unhappy than one who never faces adversity.
chinese: 从未面对逆境的人，未必真正幸福。

english: He who is brave is free.
chinese: 勇敢的人，才是自由的人。

english: Associate with people who are likely to improve you.
chinese: 与那些能让你变得更好的人同行。

english: Sometimes even to live is an act of courage.
chinese: 有时，仅仅继续活着，本身就是勇气。
